scope: Actual readout-kernel risk bound under explicit finite Taylor/error conditions and an analytic autonomous-noise counterexample; no capability trial

assumptions.force: magnitude>=96 in the actual port units, signed with observed gradient
assumptions.model: whole task objective along the one changed coordinate has the written Taylor upper bound
assumptions.error: explicit envelope on the difference between true current gradient and supplied observation; no estimator is assumed valid
assumptions.feasibility: positive signal:nonempty cell; negative signal:room in N+stock budget
assumptions.robust_domain: gradient error<=50% observed magnitude and L*quantum<=50% observed magnitude

numeric.scope: independent analytic loss differences, source row probabilities and exact rational arithmetic; no learner, epochs or empirical convergence

noise_floor.objective: theta^2 at theta0=0, supplied gradient0, available stock1
noise_floor.body: single cap2 cell, scaled quadratic H
noise_floor.significance: unconditional task descent at every state is false; finite quantum and autonomous dynamics require a noise/accuracy budget

open: actual online noise/staleness envelopes and useful selective retention over full trajectories
weak-signal/finite-precision task-risk floor and general-size temporal resource service/functional anti-monopoly
practical GPU budget and independent continual real-data convergence/quality
